topography.project_purpose: Derivatives. Structurally: 36 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 4 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 3 common project-authored base contract(s) (proxy, erc1967upgrade, constants). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
